title: Writing: My Shopping Style
writingModel: I am not someone who spends a lot of money on clothes, but I care about what I wear. My style is simple, practical, and a little bit traditional.

For everyday university life, I wear plain casual clothes — dark blue jeans, a plain cotton T-shirt, and trainers. In winter, I wear a long dark grey wool coat that I bought second-hand. It is warm enough for the cold Uralsk winters.

For special occasions, I sometimes borrow traditional Kazakh accessories from my mother — a beautiful beaded necklace or a small embroidered bag. They are too precious to wear every day, but perfect for ceremonies.
I think fast fashion is too wasteful. Cheap clothes that fall apart after a few washes are not good enough for me. I prefer to save money and buy one quality item rather than five cheap ones.
My biggest wish? A hand-stitched Kazakh-inspired jacket that is modern enough for university but traditional enough to make me proud of who I am.
